verdict.rationale: Account-data portability is a fair question for a SaaS scraping API, but the evidence never documents a way to export a user's account data in open formats or to leave. The only related item is a bare mention of 'exports' in the CLI description, with no stated scope or format. It most plausibly refers to saving scraped results to files, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
